kev_metadata.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability

title: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
